Xi Jinping Replaces Top Generals Amidst Military Shake-Up

Chinese President Xi Jinping has replaced two top generals in a significant military shake-up. The firings occurred shortly before a planned summit with U.S. President Donald Trump. Reports suggest the generals were purged due to alleged disloyalty. The specific reasons and identities of the generals were not detailed in the provided coverage.
